newsitem.title: USA: Textron drops silicon carbide fiber prices.
newsitem.headline: Textron drops silicon carbide fiber prices.

text.p: Textron Systems, a unit of Textron Inc, said Tuesday it reduced the price of two of its silicon carbide fibers, SCS-6 and SCS-ULTRA.
SCS-6 fiber prices have been cut from between 10 percent and 31 percent on quantities up to 1,000 pounds. SCS-ULTRA fibers have been cut up to 15 percent on quantities up to 100 pounds.
The company said larger price reductions on both fibers are possible at higher quantities.
Textron said its silicon carbide-reinforced titanium, aluminum and ceramic composites are well suited for aircraft engine components, landing gear, sports equipment and industrial applications.
